newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom to auction debts on Oct 11.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom to auction debts on Oct 11.

text.p: Russia's Moskovsky Vekselny Bank will auction off about 500 billion roubles of debts to the RAO Gazprom gas monopoly on October 11, a bank official said on Thursday.
The bank plans to sell debts of regional gas consumers to Gazprom branches Uraltransgas and Permtransgas at a first trial auction, credit department head Alexander Yelizarov told Reuters.
If the first auction is a success, the bank plans to organise more auctions, Yelizarov said.
Regional gas consumers' debt to Gazprom totals five trillion roubles.
The biggest debtor, whose debt amounts to 150 billion roubles, is Nizhnetagilsky Metal NTMK.RTS.
On December 31, 1995, debts to Gazprom amounted to 48.94 trillion roubles, according to a consolidated balance sheet compiled to international accounting standards by Price Waterhouse.
Many companies and public organisations do not pay their bills in Russia, leading to a non-payments crisis which is crippling the economy.
